title: OnBlow: The Balloon Dog - 3D Space Physics Arcade Game
summary: Browser arcade game: guide balloon dog Laika through starfields, Saturn orbit and spiral galaxies, bouncing on balloons to collect crystals and dodge hazards.
why: Air-jet, bouncy, checkpoint and bomb balloon variants give the core bouncing physics real variety across looping cosmic zones.

fingerprint.description: Play OnBlow: The Balloon Dog free 3D space physics arcade game in your web browser! Control Laika the balloon dog, navigate Saturn orbit & spiral galaxies, collect crystals, and dodge obstacles with zero downloads required. Developed by Architect Arthur Bigler (inlabic.com).
